headline: Multiverse Computing Announces Series C Fundraising Targeting up to $570M (€500M) to Power Efficient AI from Edge to Cloud
summary: Forgepoint Capital International, BNPP Solar Impulse Venture Fund, and Bullhound Capital lead the round as a consortium of global technology firms, sovereign funds, and strategic investors converge on efficient AISAN SEBASTIAN, Spain, July 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Multiverse Computing, the global leader in efficient AI, today announced a $570 million (€500M) Series C funding round at a $1.7 billion (€1.5B) pre-money valuation, a 5x step-up from its Series B. The round is co-led by Forgepoint
